name: gcode
summary: gcode — the gucOS line-oriented agentic coding assistant (todos/0174): Anthropic Messages API over the libcurl veneer, cJSON, and a posix_spawn /bin/sh bash tool, with busybox lineedit line editing. Reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL from the environment (export them in ~/.profile); state lives under ~/.local/state/gcode. `code` is the same binary under its back-compat name.
